Like the Mosaic law, the Sharia is the discovery of the rules that will allow believers us to obey God. Muslims understand that these rules of Sharia reflect broader purposes and values. At the same time, the Sharia prohibits false accusations of sexual immorality. This protects human dignity and honor, which are necessary for living a good life. Muslim jurists discovered these rules through 4 primary sources: the Quran, the words and actions of the Prophet Muhammad, the universal agreement about a matter by the Muslim community (or its scholars), and the careful use of analogy.
